title: lepidotheca suaveolens

It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Lepidotheca suaveolens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
